title: Motor Control Engineer
summary: Writes the control software and algorithms that make electric motors in EVs, industrial drives and home appliances run smoothly and efficiently. Sits in the powertrain or drives team, working with power electronics hardware engineers, testers and vehicle or system integrators.
dailyDuties: Develop field oriented control and PWM code for motor controllers
Tune current and speed loops on the motor test bench
Build and update motor and inverter models in MATLAB/Simulink
Debug inverter faults with oscilloscopes and debuggers
Integrate the controller with the vehicle or system over CAN
Write test reports and review results with the hardware team

skills.expectation: Implement field oriented control, SVPWM and sensorless control
Understand PMSM, BLDC and induction motor behaviour and parameters
Work with three-phase inverters, gate drivers and protection
Design and tune current and speed loops
Build motor and inverter models and do model-based design in Simulink
Write real-time control code and interrupt routines in embedded C
Use PWM, ADC and timer peripherals on C2000 or similar motor-control MCUs
Connect the motor controller to the vehicle or system over CAN
Debug on the bench with oscilloscopes, debuggers and dynamometers
Test control software on HIL benches
Follow ISO 26262 for traction motor controllers
Integrate motor control software into AUTOSAR
Understand EV powertrain and high-voltage systems
Schedule control tasks on an RTOS

certifications.why: Useful for automotive traction controller work under ISO 26262
